Studied: Business.description:
💼 You studied business: commerce classes, keeping the books for a family shop or managing a store's accounts part-time.

🌱 Budgets, contracts, marketing and how hero agencies make money. You can read a balance sheet and spot a bad deal.
⚠️ Running a real agency, managing investors and surviving a scandal are beyond you.
⚖️ No accounting certification and no capital, and only a licensed hero can found a hero agency.
🏫 It shows in practical questions about cost, revenue and who pays.

📈 Grants: Business +15
Studied: Business.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied business: budgets, accounting, marketing, staffing, contracts, brand strategy and how a hero agency or a company makes money. They can read a balance sheet and spot a bad deal. Prior study, not mastery: running a real agency, managing investors and surviving a scandal are beyond them. Not a license: it is no accounting certification and no capital, and only a licensed hero can found a hero agency. It shows in practical questions about cost, revenue and who pays.
